"Got it — Shadow Hearts' Judgement Ring, bolted onto Octagon Tactics' combat. I wrote the full spec as a file you can paste straight into an AI game maker, grounded in how your actual game works (I checked the code — `beginBattleScene`, `calcDamage`, the duel cutscene flow).

The core of it:

**The ring:** when a player unit attacks, a ring appears over the duel. Needle sweeps clockwise from 12 o'clock. Gold hit zone = normal damage, narrow red strike zone nested inside it = 1.5× crit, dark = miss, attack whiffs.

**Combos:** every successful stop spawns a new ring, up to 5 strikes per attack. Each level gets harder — needle faster (240°/s + 40 per level), zones smaller (hit 60° down to 36°, strike 14° down to 6°), a second hit zone from level 3 — and damage climbs ×1.00 to ×2.00. A miss ends the chain. Enemy counterattacks and heals never use the ring, so enemy phase stays fast.

**Technical details in the spec:** exact zone-placement rules (strike always centered inside hit, positions randomized every ring), frame-rate-independent needle math, the full combat flow before/after, a tuning table, canvas rendering notes, input handling (tap anywhere, 120ms debounce so the attack-confirm tap doesn't accidentally stop the first ring), and a copy-paste prompt for the game maker at the end.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add a Shadow Hearts-style Judgement Ring to the existing Emberfall tactical game, enabling player attacks to use timed hits, criticals, and combo chains.

## Requirements
- Gold hit zone, nested red 1.5× critical zone, dark miss; needle sweeps clockwise from 12 o’clock.
- Up to five rings per attack, progressively faster and narrower, with two hit zones from level 3 and damage multipliers through ×2.00.
- Enemy attacks and healing do not use the ring.
- Support tap/click and Space/Enter, with 120 ms debounce to avoid the attack-confirm input stopping the first ring.
- Build directly into the game, do not ask questions; note assumptions on completion.

## Decisions
- Integrated the feature into the existing tactical game in `index.html`; each successful ring adds damage and a miss ends the chain.
- Used randomized independent zone positions for each ring; tuning is encoded in `ringTuning`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added ring overlay, canvas rendering, needle animation, hit/crit/miss evaluation, combo handling, damage application, keyboard/touch controls, and 120 ms input guard in `index.html`.
- Updated in-game help text with ring controls.
- `node --check` on extracted JavaScript and `git diff --check` passed.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Add a Shadow Hearts-style Judgement Ring to the existing Emberfall tactical game, enabling timed player attacks, critical hits, and combo chains.

## Requirements
- Gold hit zone, nested red 1.5× critical zone, dark miss; needle sweeps clockwise from 12 o’clock.
- Up to five rings per attack, progressively faster and narrower; two hit zones from level 3 and damage multipliers through ×2.00.
- Enemy attacks and healing do not use the ring.
- Support tap/click and Space/Enter, with 120 ms debounce after opening the ring.
- Build directly into the game, do not ask questions; note assumptions on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport at most 1280px wide) for visual checks.

## Decisions
- Integrated the feature into the existing tactical game in `index.html`; each successful ring adds damage and a miss ends the chain.
- Ring zones are randomized independently for each ring; tuning is encoded in `ringTuning`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added ring overlay, canvas rendering, clockwise needle animation, hit/critical/miss evaluation, combo handling, damage application, keyboard/touch controls, and 120 ms input guard.
- Updated in-game help text with ring controls.
- Passed JavaScript syntax validation and `git diff --check`.
- Browser-tested ring visibility/miss outcome and a five-level chain; max-chain test recorded four successful strikes and one miss, then closed the ring and applied damage.
- Screenshot saved at `/tmp/opencode/emberfall-final.jpg` (earlier visual check: `/tmp/opencode/emberfall-ring.jpg`).

### Active
- Review final behavior for any remaining issues; mobile viewport and complete successful five-ring chain were not conclusively verified.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` could not start because its expected Chromium installation is missing; direct Playwright using `/usr/bin/chromium` worked.

## Next Move
1. Inspect ring timing and end-of-chain outcome in `index.html`; address any issues found.
2. Run a direct Playwright check of a fully successful five-hit chain and mobile viewport, if practical.
3. Report the implemented change, testing, and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: existing Emberfall game and all Judgement Ring implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Direct Playwright smoke tests used `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules/playwright-core` with `/usr/bin/chromium`.
- One automated chain test produced `CRITICAL!, STRIKE!, STRIKE!, STRIKE!, MISS`; combat log confirmed four strikes applied 28 damage and the ring closed.
- Earlier smoke test verified an attack opens the ring and a miss is displayed.
